indexObservation.sourceTitle: How much do hostels cost around the world? Hostel Price Index for 2023 - Price of Travel
indexObservation.evidenceText: The Price of Travel Hostel Index table lists London, England, Clink261, at $35.35 per night. Its methodology states that the price is for one person in a shared dorm room, including taxes and fees, using the average of a Thursday and Friday night in mid-April 2023.
indexObservation.referencePeriod: Average Thursday and Friday night in mid-April 2023; article dated 2023-01-16.
indexObservation.searchQuery: site:priceoftravel.com/how-much-do-hostels-cost-around-the-world London England Hostel Index dorm bed price
indexObservation.reason: Exact city row and source-defined one-person shared-dorm observation found; no conversion or ratio calculated.

currentBenchmark.evidenceText: The public search returned the exact Clink261 property and one-guest dorm rows, but the available strict candidates were either a limited-time deal/sale price or a price shown only as a multi-night total. The result therefore did not provide a non-sale, single-night, tax-resolved nightly benchmark that satisfies the contract.
currentBenchmark.referencePeriod: Booking search result displayed a three-night stay; retrieved 2026-08-01.
currentBenchmark.searchQuery: Clink261 London current shared dorm bed one person nightly price taxes included
currentBenchmark.reason: No strict current benchmark: one candidate was a limited-time deal and the non-sale candidate did not state a nightly price separately from its three-night total. Fail closed without inferring or dividing.
